description: This file contains a JUnit test class 'OrderTest' for the 'Order' class in the OpenMRS core project, primarily testing the behavior of order lifecycle methods, status checks, and copying/revision methods.

classes.name: OrderTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing various methods and behaviors of the 'Order' class within the OpenMRS project, including status checks, cloning, and date calculations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup before each test, setting date format and creating a new Order instance.

methods.name: assertThatAllFieldsAreCopied
methods.description: Utility method to assert that all fields of an Order are properly copied in clone or copy methods, excluding specified fields.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldNotDiscontinueGivenOrderWithoutDates
methods.description: Tests that an order without activation or end dates is not considered discontinued at a given date.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldNotDiscontinueBeforeActivationDate
methods.description: Tests that an order is not discontinued before its activation date.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldNotDiscontinueGivenActivatedOrderWithoutEndDate
methods.description: Tests that an active order without an end date is not considered discontinued.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldNotDiscontinueActivatedOrderBeforeAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Ensures that an order is not discontinued before its auto-expire date.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldNotDiscontinueActivatedOrderAfterAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Ensures that an order is not discontinued after its auto-expire date.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldNotDiscontinueActivatedOrderBeforeOrderStopDate
methods.description: Checks that an order isn't discontinued before its stop date.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldDiscontinueActivatedOrderAfterOrderStopDate
methods.description: Checks that an order is discontinued after its stop date.

methods.name: isActive_shouldBeCurrentAfterDateActivated
methods.description: Tests that an order is active after its activation date.

methods.name: isActive_shouldBeCurrentBetweenDateActivatedAndAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Tests that an order is active between its activation and auto-expire dates.

methods.name: isActive_shouldBeCurrentBetweenDateActivatedAndDateStopped
methods.description: Tests that an order is active between its activation date and stop date.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuing_shouldSetAllTheRelevantFields
methods.description: Verifies that cloning an order for discontinuation copies the correct fields and resets necessary properties.

methods.name: copy_shouldCopyAllFields
methods.description: Tests that the copy method duplicates all fields correctly.

methods.name: cloneForRevision_shouldSetAllTheRelevantFields
methods.description: Verifies cloning for revision copies the correct fields with appropriate adjustments.

methods.name: isType_shouldTrueIfItIsTheSameOrIsASubtype
methods.description: Checks that the order's type matches given type or is a subtype.

methods.name: isType_shouldFalseIfItNeitherTheSameNorASubtype
methods.description: Confirms that type mismatch returns false.

methods.name: cloneForRevision_shouldSetTheRelevantFieldsForADCOrder
methods.description: Ensures specific fields are reset or retained properly when cloning an order.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfOtherOrderIsNull
methods.description: Tests equality comparison with null.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnFalseIfTheConceptOfTheOrdersDoNotMatch
methods.description: Verifies that orders with different concepts are not considered the same.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs_shouldReturnTrueIfTheOrdersHaveTheSameConcept
methods.description: Checks that orders with the same concept are considered the same.

methods.name: getEffectiveStartDate_shouldReturnScheduledDateIfUrgencyIsScheduled
methods.description: Returns scheduled date if order urgency is scheduled.

methods.name: getEffectiveStartDate_shouldReturnDateActivatedIfUrgencyIsNotScheduled
methods.description: Returns activation date if order urgency is not scheduled.

methods.name: getEffectiveStopDate_shouldReturnDateStoppedIfDateStoppedIsNotNull
methods.description: Returns stop date if it exists.

methods.name: getEffectiveStopDate_shouldReturnAutoExpireDateIfDateStoppedIsNull
methods.description: Returns auto-expire date if stop date is null.

methods.name: isFuture_shouldReturnFalseForAVoidedOrder
methods.description: Checks that a voided order is not considered in the future.

methods.name: isFuture_shouldReturnFalseIfDateActivatedIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that an order without activation date isn't considered in the future.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldReturnFalseForAVoidedOrder
methods.description: Order voided check for discontinued status.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldReturnFalseIfDateStoppedAndAutoExpireDateAreBothNull
methods.description: Verifies that an order with no stop or expiry date isn’t discontinued.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldReturnFalseIfAutoExpireDateIsNullAndDateStoppedIsEqualToCheckDate
methods.description: Order with stop date equal to check date and no expiry date is not discontinued.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldReturnFalseIfAutoExpireDateIsNullAndDateStoppedIsAfterCheckDate
methods.description: Order with stop date after check date is not discontinued.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldReturnFalseIfDateActivatedIsAfterCheckDate
methods.description: Order activated after check date isn't discontinued.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldReturnTrueIfAutoExpireDateIsNullAndDateStoppedIsBeforeCheckDate
methods.description: Order with stop date before check date and no expiry date is discontinued.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldFailIfDateStoppedIsAfterAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Test that exception is thrown if stop date is after auto-expire date.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldReturnTrueIfCheckDateIsAfterDateStoppedButBeforeAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Order is discontinued if check date falls after stop date but before expiry.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldReturnTrueIfCheckDateIsAfterBothDateStoppedAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Discontinued if check date is after both stop and expiry dates.

methods.name: isDiscontinued_shouldReturnTrueIfTheOrderIsScheduledForTheFutureAndActivatedOnCheckDateButTheCheckDateIsAfterDateStopped
methods.description: Special case when a scheduled order is stopped before activation date.

methods.name: isExpired_shouldReturnFalseForAVoidedOrder
methods.description: Checks that a voided order is not expired.

methods.name: isExpired_shouldReturnFalseIfDateStoppedAndAutoExpireDateAreBothNull
methods.description: Order without stop or expiry date isn't expired.

methods.name: isExpired_shouldReturnFalseIfDateStoppedIsNullAndAutoExpireDateIsEqualToCheckDate
methods.description: Order with auto-expire date equal to check date isn't expired.

methods.name: isExpired_shouldReturnFalseIfDateStoppedIsNullAndAutoExpireDateIsAfterCheckDate
methods.description: Order with expiry after check date isn't expired.

methods.name: isExpired_shouldReturnFalseIfCheckDateIsAfterBothDateStoppedAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Order expired if check date is after stop and expiry dates.

methods.name: isExpired_shouldReturnFalseIfDateActivatedIsAfterCheckDate
methods.description: Order activated after check date isn't expired.

methods.name: isActivated_shouldReturnTrueIfAnOrderWasActivatedOnTheCheckDate
methods.description: Checks activation on the exact date.

methods.name: isActivated_shouldReturnTrueIfAnOrderWasActivatedBeforeTheCheckDate
methods.description: Order activated before check date is active.

methods.name: isActivated_shouldReturnFalseIfDateActivatedIsNull
methods.description: Order without activation date isn't active.

methods.name: isActivated_shouldReturnFalseForAnOrderActivatedAfterTheCheckDate
methods.description: Order activated after check date isn't active.

methods.name: isActive_shouldReturnTrueIfAnOrderExpiredOnTheCheckDate
methods.description: Order that expires on check date is active.

methods.name: isActive_shouldReturnTrueIfAnOrderWasActivatedOnTheCheckDateButScheduledForTheFuture
methods.description: Order scheduled for future activation but considered active on activation date.

methods.name: isActive_shouldReturnTrueIfAnOrderWasDiscontinuedOnTheCheckDate
methods.description: Order stopped on check date is active.

methods.name: isActive_shouldReturnFalseForADiscontinuedOrder
methods.description: Discontinued order is not active.

methods.name: isActive_shouldReturnFalseForAnExpiredOrder
methods.description: Expired order is not active.

methods.name: isStarted_shouldReturnFalseForAVoidedOrder
methods.description: Voided order isn't considered started.

methods.name: isStarted_shouldReturnFalseIfDateActivatedIsNull
methods.description: Order without activation date isn't started.

methods.name: isStarted_shouldReturnFalseIfTheOrderIsNotYetActivatedAsOfTheCheckDate
methods.description: Order activated after check date isn't started.

methods.name: isStarted_shouldReturnFalseIfTheOrderWasScheduledToStartAfterTheCheckDate
methods.description: Scheduled order not started if scheduled after check date.

methods.name: isStarted_shouldReturnTrueIfTheOrderWasScheduledToStartOnTheCheckDate
methods.description: Order scheduled to start on check date is started.

methods.name: isStarted_shouldReturnTrueIfTheOrderWasScheduledToStartBeforeTheCheckDate
methods.description: Order scheduled to start before check date is started.

methods.name: isStarted_shouldReturnTrueIfTheOrderIsStartedAndNotScheduled
methods.description: Order with activation date set is considered started regardless of schedule.
